title: papaver radicatum var. pygmaeum
intro: Papaver radicatum var. pygmaeum, commonly known as Dwarf Alpine Poppy, is a compact and delicate variant of the Papaver radicatum species, characterized by its small, round leaves and vibrant yellow to orange flowers. The health benefits of Papaver radicatum var. pygmaeum include its potential to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, it is believed to have analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions. The bioactive constituents of Papaver radicatum var. pygmaeum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
